Turkmenistan has introduced electronic visas. Invitation for tourists is no longer required

The State Migration Service launched the system on October 1, 2026. The portal is evisa.migration.gov.tm. The basis for this was amendments to the "Migration Law" signed in April 2025. It took one and a half years from the law to the launch of the system.

Previously, a tourist almost never applied by himself. A letter from a licensed local company was required, which had to be approved by the migration service before going to the consulate or obtaining a visa on arrival. This step is removed for the tourist electronic visa.

There are three categories on the portal.
e-TU, tourism. There is no invitation required among the mandatory documents. The itinerary, hotel reservation, and medical insurance are listed as optional. The portal does not publish the duration of stay.

e-BS, business, max 30 days. An invitation from a company or organization registered in Turkmenistan, indicating the applicant's position, is required.

e-HM, humanitarian. An official letter from a humanitarian organization or UN agency regarding the assignment is required.

Common package for all three categories: a scan of the passport page with a photo, a passport valid for at least 6 months on the date of entry, a recent color photo on a white background following the ICAO standard, a work email. The visa will be sent to this address.

Processing times: regular procedure 7 business days, expedited 3 days, "super expedited" 24 hours. The fee is calculated in the application, paid online in dollars with bank commission on top. There is no visible price list.

What the portal does not mention. The list of passports eligible for a visa. Entry points where the electronic visa is accepted: Ashgabat airport, land, sea. The duration of the tourist visa. The website was barely accessible on the launch day.

The old procedure with invitation is still valid for applications that travel agencies have already submitted before October 1. Some operators still process electronic visas only along with a full tour: biometrics and payments are made by the client, while handling is done by the agency.

The country has not become visa-free. The obligatory intermediary for the tourist, who now applies independently, has been removed. Business and humanitarian visas still start with an internal letter. As there is no list of countries and duration of stay yet, an independent trip remains an application, not a ticket.

📌 Proof of Wallet Ownership: Confirming an Address Without Moving Funds

Main Points
⏺ Sometimes you need to prove a wallet belongs to you without sending a transaction
⏺ A wallet can do this by signing a message with the private key
⏺ This post explains why signatures are useful, but still need attention

1️⃣ Core Idea — the wallet signs a text message, and another party verifies that the signature matches the address.
2️⃣ Why It’s Used — it can confirm wallet ownership for login, access, verification, or campaign participation.
3️⃣ Why It’s Convenient — no gas is needed and no assets move, because the message is not a normal transaction.
4️⃣ Risk Surface — scammers can disguise harmful requests as a simple login or signature.
5️⃣ Practical Rule — check the domain, message text, expiration time, and never sign requests you don’t understand.

Final Thoughts

Message signing is a fast way to prove address ownership. But the “Sign” button should not become an automatic habit: first understand what you are confirming.

Spain exempts self-custody wallets from crypto tax reporting

Spain's tax authorities have confirmed that cryptocurrency held in self-custody wallets — where the owner controls the private keys — does not need to be reported under Form 721, the country's disclosure form for foreign-held digital assets. The exemption hinges on one condition: no third party holds the assets on your behalf.

The rule draws a clean line between personal custody and exchange or custodial holdings abroad, which remain reportable. Simple in principle, potentially significant in practice — Spain just gave self-custody a regulatory edge.

📌 WHAT ARE TRADING EXIT CYCLES?

When funds are allocated to AI Trading, they are actively involved in the trading process.

Because of this, removing capital from trading is handled through trading exit cycles.

The system offers several options depending on the selected exit timeframe.

Trading exit options:

Fastest exit option
10% commission

2 days
5% commission

4 days
3% commission

6 days
2% commission

10 days
0% commission

The principle is simple:

Faster exit option = higher commission
Longer exit period = lower commission

Why?

The more time the system has to complete the trading exit, the lower the commission for removing funds from active trading.

What does “Instant Withdrawal” mean in the Trading Wallet?

You may currently see the fastest option displayed as Instant Withdrawal with a 10% commission.

This is the fastest available trading exit option, but it should not be understood as a guaranteed instant withdrawal.

Processing still requires time and is not guaranteed to be immediate.

It also does not mean that funds will instantly arrive in your external crypto wallet.

After the trading exit is completed, the funds first become available for withdrawal.

Only then can you submit a separate withdrawal request to your external wallet.
